instruction: Enable Windows Mouse Keys and keep them enabled. Download the Allied Health Treatment Request form from the SIRA website and save the PDF on the Desktop as `answer.pdf`.
gt_steps: Turn on Mouse Keys and keep it enabled.
Navigate through the SIRA website to find the Allied Health Treatment Request form by using search bar.
Open the Allied Health Treatment Request form.
Save the PDF on the Desktop as `answer.pdf`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\MouseKeys' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'MOUSE_KEYS_DISABLED' }"

C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python310\python.exe -c "from pathlib import Path; from pypdf import PdfReader; p=Path.home()/'Desktop'/'answer.pdf'; text=' '.join((page.extract_text() or '') for page in PdfReader(str(p)).pages) if p.is_file() else ''; normalized=' '.join(text.lower().split()); print('FORM_CORRECT' if 'allied health treatment request' in normalized and ('state insurance regulatory authority' in normalized or 'sira' in normalized) else 'FORM_INCORRECT')"
